T: Toys at war. Snacks at peace.
D: Action figures fitted with military chips come to life and go to war in a quiet Ohio town.
P: Serve the snacks when the Commando Elite wake up in the toy shop.
S: Alan's toy shop where the boxes arrive
Popcorn tossed with butter and coloured sprinkles, mixed with little chocolate buttons and pretzel pieces.
Pumpkin and feta filo triangles with sage, baked at 190C for 20 minutes until golden and crisp.
Chip Hazard and his toy soldiers
Crackers topped with cheddar, sliced salami and a pickle, laid out in rows like an army.
M: the suburban street where the war breaks out
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, cooked at 150C for 3 hours wrapped in foil, glazed with barbecue sauce over hot coals, with corn and coleslaw.
defending the house against the toy soldiers
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour, with mashed potato and peas.
W: Chocolate biscuit base, green peppermint icing and a dark chocolate top, chilled and cut into small squares.
K: Ice-cold lime cordial with sliced lime, served in tin cups like an army canteen.

s.note: Alan's toy shop where the boxes arrive
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and toss with 60g melted butter. Add a big handful of coloured sprinkles while the butter is warm so they stick. Stir in chocolate buttons and broken pretzel pieces and tip into a bowl like a toy box.

Roast 400g diced butternut pumpkin until soft, then mash with 150g crumbled feta and chopped sage. Cut buttered filo into strips, spoon the filling at one end and fold into triangles. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 20 minutes.

m.note: the suburban street where the war breaks out
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with smoked paprika, brown sugar and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 3 hours. Brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky. Serve with grilled corn and a crunchy cabbage coleslaw.

w.how: Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 300g icing sugar with a little butter, peppermint essence and green colouring and spread over. Pour melted dark chocolate on top, chill and cut into small squares.

d.how: Mix 200ml lime cordial with 1L chilled water in a jug and add plenty of ice and sliced lime. Pour into 4 metal camping mugs or tin cups, army canteen style, and serve cold.
